transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Could you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because after my cashier shifts, I keep buying really big takeout orders. Like… burgers, fries, chicken, desserts—enough for a whole family, honestly—and then I’ll sit and eat almost all of it myself before I go home.
When you're eating all that takeout, do you ever feel like you can't stop or control what you're eating?

Yeah. Once I take that first bite, it’s like something just shuts off in me. I’ll be thinking, Demetrius, stop, you don’t need more, but my hands keep grabbing the next thing anyway. I feel like I’m not really in control of it.
Do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than normal during these episodes?
I’m not really sure about the speed. I know I eat a lot, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether I’m eating faster than normal.
Do you find yourself eating until you feel uncomfortably full during these episodes?

Yeah. A lot of nights I keep eating past the point where I’m full. My stomach gets really tight and starts hurting, and I’ll have to lean the seat back in the car or just lie still in bed and wait for it to pass.
Do you usually eat all of this takeout alone, or are you often with other people when you eat this way?

Usually alone. I’m embarrassed by how much I get, so I try to hide it. Sometimes I’ll sit in the parking lot and eat it there, or I’ll wait until my wife is asleep. Then I’ll shove the bags and receipts down in the trash so she doesn’t see how much I had.
Does this eating behavior bother you a lot or cause problems in your daily life, like with work, relationships, or how you see yourself?

Yeah, it does. I still make it to my cashier shifts and all that, but it’s messing things up at home. I’m spending money we really don’t have on food, and then I hide it from my wife. It just makes me feel like I’m lying all the time, and things feel tense between us.
After you finish eating all that takeout, do you feel disgusted with yourself, guilty, or depressed about it?
I don’t know exactly how to put it. I usually feel pretty bad after, like I’m disappointed in myself. I’ll sit there thinking, “Why did I do that again?” It’s not a good feeling.
How often do you find yourself eating this way—like a loss of control with eating a lot of takeout alone—does that happen at least once a week?

Yeah. It’s more than once a week. For the last several months, it’s been like three or four nights most weeks. And honestly, since those foreclosure calls started, I can’t think of a week where I didn’t do it at least once.
